title: mpboot_llm
description:
Source code for mpboot_llm, a pipeline for generating R2RML mappings from relational database dumps and ontologies with LLM-based agents, together with scripts for benchmark preparation, evaluation, and result summary generation.

Authors are listed in paper order.
